description: Player NBT and item predicates in commands (#204): nbt= selectors see the player's SelectedItem, Inventory with components, abilities, OnGround and fall_distance (NbtPredicate.getEntityTagToCompare); execute if items and clear take item predicates with component tests (=, ~ with count, damage, custom_data and enchantments, presence, ! and |). Each passing check sets a gold block.

actions.command: item replace entity @e container.2 with minecraft:dirt 2
execute if entity @e[nbt={SelectedItem:{id:"minecraft:diamond_sword"}}] run setblock 0 -56 0 minecraft:gold_block
execute if entity @e[nbt={Inventory:[{id:"minecraft:diamond_sword",components:{"minecraft:custom_data":{a:1b}}}]}] run setblock 1 -56 0 minecraft:gold_block
execute if entity @e[nbt={abilities:{mayfly:0b},OnGround:1b,fall_distance:0.0d}] run setblock 2 -56 0 minecraft:gold_block
execute if items entity @e weapon.mainhand minecraft:diamond_sword[minecraft:damage=5] run setblock 3 -56 0 minecraft:gold_block
execute if items entity @e weapon.mainhand *[minecraft:damage~{damage:{min:3},durability:{min:1000}}] run setblock 4 -56 0 minecraft:gold_block
execute if items entity @e weapon.mainhand *[minecraft:custom_data~{a:1b}] run setblock 5 -56 0 minecraft:gold_block
execute if items entity @e weapon.mainhand *[minecraft:max_damage,count=1,!minecraft:food] run setblock 6 -56 0 minecraft:gold_block
execute if items entity @e weapon.mainhand *[minecraft:damage=4|minecraft:custom_data~{a:1b}] run setblock 7 -56 0 minecraft:gold_block
execute if items entity @e container.* minecraft:dirt[minecraft:count~{min:3}] run setblock 8 -56 0 minecraft:gold_block
execute unless items entity @e container.* minecraft:dirt[minecraft:custom_data~{b:2b}] if items entity @e container.* minecraft:dirt[!minecraft:custom_data] run setblock 9 -56 0 minecraft:gold_block
execute if items entity @e weapon.mainhand *[minecraft:enchantments~[{levels:{min:1}}]] run setblock 10 -56 0 minecraft:gold_block
execute if items entity @e weapon.mainhand *[minecraft:enchantments~[{enchantments:"minecraft:sharpness",levels:{min:2}}]] run setblock 11 -56 0 minecraft:gold_block
